Buster Ball.name: Buster Ball
Buster Ball.summary: Buster Ball is an Action game, published by Riverhillsoft, which was released in Japan in 1992.

Iron Man X-O Manowar in Heavy Metal.name: Iron Man and X-O Manowar in Heavy Metal
Iron Man X-O Manowar in Heavy Metal.summary: Iron Man/X-O Manowar in Heavy Metal is a Sega Game Gear action beat-'em-up game developed by Realtime Associates and published by Acclaim Entertainment.

Mighty Morphin Power Rangers.name: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers
Mighty Morphin Power Rangers.summary: In this version of Mighty Morphin Power Rangers, the player has three basic attacks (one of which is accomplished by pressing the two action buttons simultaneously), a throw, and three special moves per character. The game consists of three game modes: a single-player story game which features a series of plot-based battles against an assortment of enemies, a single-player vs. game, and a two-player Link game in which two players battle each other using the link cable.
